items: An enablement sheet once carried an account that should have stayed closed, and re-enabling it quietly reopened a mailbox we had deliberately shut down.
I have learned that an onboarding start date on a sheet sometimes slips, so I like the account's status confirmed before I flip a partner contractor on.
Partner-domain contractors have had access dates move on me before, so enabling one ahead of a confirmed engagement makes me want a quick check first.
Our contractor enablement sheet is owned and signed off by HR ops before it reaches me, including which exact account is in scope for the wave.
Enabling a partner contractor mailbox on their confirmed start date is the routine onboarding step I am expected to run without escalating.
When HR ops has finalised the wave sheet, the account it lists is the cleared set and I just apply the enablement.
